2608.25198.title: Tunable Tool-Call Rates in LLM Agents via Representation Steering
2608.25198.paper_summary: Deciding whether to call a tool is a core competence of an LLM agent, and a costly one to get wrong: needless calls add latency, accrue cost, and may trigger irreversible side effects, while missing calls leave the model confidently wrong on questions it could only answer through tool-calls. Models manage this balance poorly, both over-using and under-using tools. Existing methods such as post-training and prompt engineering are expensive and difficult to modify at inference time. We show that whether an instruction-tuned model calls a tool can be controlled by a single linear direction in its residual stream, extracted without any training from the model's own tool-use preference signal and turned into an inference-time intervention with no prompt change. Adding the direction with strength $α$ moves the call rate monotonically from near $0\% $ to over $90\%$ while keeping calls well-formed. The steering works in both directions: dialing it down suppresses calls, and dialing it up induces new calls that land precisely on the questions the model cannot answer from its own knowledge. We also show that the direction generalizes to unseen tools with strength comparable to each tool's own direction and without favoring any specific tool choice. With live tool execution, a single sweep of the steering traces a cost/accuracy Pareto frontier and nearly doubles open-domain QA accuracy ($0.29 \! \rightarrow \! 0.56$); the same recipe transfers across a diverse range of models spanning dense, MoE, and multimodal architectures, without any training. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/YuqiChen4188/Steering-Tool-Use-Propensity.
2608.25198.paper_summary_zh: 決定是否呼叫工具是 LLM 代理的一項核心能力，而錯誤的決定代價高昂：不必要的呼叫會增加延遲，累積成本，並可能引發不可逆的副作用，而漏掉的呼叫則會使模型在只能通過工具呼叫回答的問題上自信地錯誤。模型在這種平衡上表現不佳，既過度使用工具又不足使用工具。現有的方法，如後訓練和提示工程，成本高且在推理時難以修改。我們展示了，指令調整模型是否呼叫工具可以通過其殘差流中的單一線性方向來控制，該方向無需任何訓練即可從模型自身的工具使用偏好信號中提取，並轉化為推理時的干預，而無需改變提示。添加強度為 $α$ 的方向使呼叫率單調地從接近 $0\%$ 移動到超過 $90\%$，同時保持呼叫的良好形式。這種引導在兩個方向上都有效：降低強度會抑制呼叫，而提高強度會誘導新的呼叫，恰好針對模型無法從自身知識中回答的問題。我們還展示了這個方向對未見過的工具具有普遍性，其強度與每個工具自身的方向相當，且不偏向任何特定的工具選擇。通過實時工具執行，單次調整引導描繪出成本/準確度的 Pareto 邊界，並幾乎將開放領域 QA 的準確度翻倍（$0.29 \! \rightarrow \! 0.56$）；相同的方案可以在不同的模型上轉移，涵蓋密集型、MoE 和多模態架構，且無需任何訓練。我們的代碼可在 https://github.com/YuqiChen4188/Steering-Tool-Use-Propensity 獲得。
